_comment: Pelican/Pterodactyl egg for ShreddedPaper (multi-threaded Purpur fork) - https://github.com/MultiPaper/ShreddedPaper
name: ShreddedPaper
author: contact@hiorcraft.dev
description: ShreddedPaper is an open-source, multi-threaded server software designed for Minecraft and built on top of Purpur. By letting multiple threads work together on a single world, ShreddedPaper aims to bring vertical scaling to Minecraft and run more players on a single server. Plugins with Folia support will most likely work out of the box.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# ShreddedPaper installation script for Pelican
# Server files are located in /mnt/server

PROJECT=shreddedpaper
API_URL="https://api.multipaper.io/v2/projects/${PROJECT}"

if ! command -v jq > /dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v curl > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  apt update && apt install -y curl jq
fi

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server || exit 1

# Resolve Minecraft version
if [ -z "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" ] || [ "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
  MINECRAFT_VERSION=$(curl -fsSL "${API_URL}" | jq -r '.versions[-1] // empty' 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -z "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Could not reach the ShreddedPaper API (${API_URL})."
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "Latest Minecraft version: ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
fi

VERSION_INFO=$(curl -fsSL "${API_URL}/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}")
BUILD_COUNT=$(echo "${VERSION_INFO}" | jq -r '.builds | length' 2>/dev/null)
if [ -z "${BUILD_COUNT}" ] || [ "${BUILD_COUNT}" == "0" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: Version ${MINECRAFT_VERSION} was not found for ShreddedPaper."
  echo "Available versions:"
  curl -fsSL "${API_URL}" | jq -r '.versions[]'
  exit 1
fi

# Resolve build
if [ -z "${BUILD_NUMBER}" ] || [ "${BUILD_NUMBER}" == "latest" ]; then
  BUILD_NUMBER=$(echo "${VERSION_INFO}" | jq -r '.builds[-1]')
  echo "Latest build: ${BUILD_NUMBER}"
fi

BUILD_INFO=$(curl -fsSL "${API_URL}/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}/builds/${BUILD_NUMBER}")
JAR_NAME=$(echo "${BUILD_INFO}" | jq -r '.downloads.application.name // empty' 2>/dev/null)
JAR_SHA256=$(echo "${BUILD_INFO}" | jq -r '.downloads.application.sha256 // empty' 2>/dev/null)

if [ -z "${JAR_NAME}" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: Build ${BUILD_NUMBER} was not found for ShreddedPaper ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}."
  echo "Available builds: $(echo "${VERSION_INFO}" | jq -r '.builds | map(tostring) | join(", ")')"
  exit 1
fi

DOWNLOAD_URL="${API_URL}/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}/builds/${BUILD_NUMBER}/downloads/${JAR_NAME}"
echo "Downloading: ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

# Download to a temporary file first, so an existing jar is only replaced after a successful download
if ! curl -fL -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}.download" "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"; then
  echo "ERROR: Download failed."
  rm -f "${SERVER_JARFILE}.download"
  exit 1
fi

# Verify checksum
if [ -n "${JAR_SHA256}" ]; then
  if echo "${JAR_SHA256}  ${SERVER_JARFILE}.download" | sha256sum -c --status -; then
    echo "Checksum verified."
  else
    echo "ERROR: Checksum mismatch, the downloaded file is corrupted."
    rm -f "${SERVER_JARFILE}.download"
    exit 1
  fi
fi

mv -f "${SERVER_JARFILE}.download" "${SERVER_JARFILE}"

if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
  echo "server-port=25565" > server.properties
fi

echo "ShreddedPaper ${MINECRAFT_VERSION} build ${BUILD_NUMBER} has been installed."
